snippet.title: Godslayer Arena - Steam Next Fest Trailer
snippet.description:
Godslayer Arena is a roguelike fusion of auto battler and action RPG. The core gameplay loop revolves around drafting spells to synergize with each other, and figuring out where they should be placed. You have no control once combat begins, and your survival will depend on the strength of the build you have drafted.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2870430/Godslayer_Arena/

Meet the dev: https://hipporidergames.com/

#GodslayerArena #indiegame
